modules.name: Captain Bonny
modules.note: Solo opponent; can also join a multiplayer game.

steps.text: Board and Lighthouse in the center; resources on their Shoreline spots
Point tokens and Treasure tokens in separate piles near the board
Sort the Map tiles by type, stack each ascending with the 2-point Map on top; use {n}
steps.note: Captain Bonny counts as a player here

steps.text: Shuffle the Island tiles; {n} faceup on the Island spots, box the rest
Windrose tiles into A and B stacks, shuffle each facedown on its spot, reveal the top tile of each
Shuffle the deck; {n} cards faceup in the Bay (stack duplicates by name and refill)
Deck facedown left of the Lighthouse; discard pile forms facedown on its right

steps.note: Each player may redraw their whole hand once during setup

steps.text: Each player picks a Worker type: 2 workers in their area, 1 in a Ship on the start of the Ship track, 3 near the top of the board / Lighthouse
Bonny gets a color (she prefers red); her 2 reference cards and the Plan Card mark her city
Choose a Challenge Level; mark it with an Anchor token
Color Markers shuffled facedown onto the Plan Card's bottom row, then flip: Purple up to #2, Red, Blue and Tan to #3, Green stays on #4
Shuffle the Route cards facedown next to Bonny's city
Bonny is always last and starts with only 2 facedown cards; she sets up workers as normal but gets no Anchor tokens
Treasure can pay for any resource, but isn't a resource itself
Resources, Treasure and points are unlimited - substitute if they run out
